actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original complete full-body game sprite for star formation girl. Frame11 of SOUTHEAST walking cycle. Reference1 is exact original identity, reference2 is main confirmed paint finish, reference3 fixes the SE direction, head/torso scale and prop placement.
Camera must show FRONT THREE-QUARTER VIEW turned 45 degrees toward screen RIGHT, walking diagonally DOWN-RIGHT toward viewer. BOTH eyes visible, far eye narrower, nose and chest angled DOWN-RIGHT, not pure side, not front, no back view. This is SE. Keep large rounded chibi head and compact short limbs (2.3 heads tall), high brown-black bun and long dark hair, gold-and-red-star crown, forehead tiny star, cheerful amber/ruby eyes. Original black/ivory/red Daoist robe with warm gold celestial patterns, orbit waist pendants, black-gold red-star boots.
Anatomical RIGHT hand (viewer-left/near) holds round astrolabe with short handle. Anatomical LEFT hand (viewer-right/far) holds exactly three fan-shaped star cards. Do not swap props, add weapon, staff, background or magical floor.
POSE Phase11 RIGHT support, LEFT initial swing. Near RIGHT leg supports weight and boot is flat under the body. Far LEFT knee bends, heel lifts behind and its boot clears ground by 28pixels. Thigh still trailing. One grounded sole only. Clear asymmetry. Keep exact45degree SE torso/face and original prop placements. Calm steady upperbody, hair and robe tiny follow-through. Newly draw leg articulation.
Native one whole character on square canvas at least1024x1024, actual transparent RGBA background. Full crown-to-sole height about900pixels and body pivot (512,942) in1024 coordinates. Entire character, hair, props, tassels and boots within margin. No shadows, floor, labels, text, checkerboard. Polished rounded Chinese Daoist painted chibi finish, fine warm gold details, clean silhouette. Never mirror, copy, interpolate or warp a previous pose; newly draw this exact direction and phase.
